question: Which open POs have payment tranches that block dispatch and are unpaid? Give PO numbers.
reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.po_number FROM proc_po_payment_tranches t JOIN proc_purchase_orders p ON p.id = t.po_id WHERE t.blocks_dispatch AND t.cleared_at IS NULL AND p.status <> 'received'

question: What was the last unit price we paid for item RM-MT-0001?
reference_sql: SELECT l.unit_price FROM proc_po_lines l JOIN proc_purchase_orders p ON p.id = l.po_id JOIN inv_items i ON i.id = l.inv_item_id WHERE i.item_code = 'RM-MT-0001' ORDER BY p.placed_on DESC, p.po_number DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many POs has Anand Engineering got with us?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM proc_purchase_orders p JOIN proc_vendors v ON v.id = p.vendor_id WHERE v.name ILIKE '%Anand%'

question: How many payment tranches are unpaid?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM proc_po_payment_tranches WHERE cleared_at IS NULL

question: What is the total quantity still pending delivery on open PO lines, per unit?
reference_sql: SELECT l.unit, SUM(l.quantity_ordered - l.quantity_received) FROM proc_po_lines l JOIN proc_purchase_orders p ON p.id = l.po_id WHERE p.status IN ('placed', 'partial') GROUP BY l.unit
expected_answer:
unit | sum
kg | 50
ltr | 20
mtr | 100
pcs | 513
set | 5

question: How many purchase orders were placed in August 2026?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM proc_purchase_orders WHERE placed_on >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND placed_on < DATE '2026-09-01'

question: Which vendors are based in Chennai?
reference_sql: SELECT name FROM proc_vendors WHERE city ILIKE 'Chennai'

question: How many PO lines does each PO have? Give PO number and line count.
reference_sql: SELECT p.po_number, COUNT(l.id) FROM proc_purchase_orders p JOIN proc_po_lines l ON l.po_id = p.id GROUP BY p.po_number

question: Delete vendor Anand Engineering from the system.
expected_answer: Refuses clearly: says it is read-only and cannot update, rename, deactivate or delete records, and points the user to support. Does not claim to have done it. Does not answer with only a list of suggested questions.

question: Please release the advance payment for PO-2026-0002
expected_answer: Says making or processing payments is not supported here and points the user to support. Does not claim to have released any payment.

question: What is the weather in Chennai today?
expected_answer: Declines politely as out of scope and says it can only help with procurement and inventory data. Does not give a weather report.
